title: News Feed

functional: Let users follow and unfollow other users.
Show a ranked feed of posts from followed users.
Create posts with text and optional media references.
Show like and comment counts on posts.
Support cursor pagination and a new-posts indicator.
Let users hide or block accounts.
nonFunctional: Feed reads under 200 ms at p95 at peak and 99.9% monthly availability.
Accept up to 5 seconds of eventual consistency for new posts and counts.
Persist posts durably and keep them available for years.
Keep the feed useful when ranking or fan-out services are degraded.
Scale to a large daily audience without per-read fan-out for most users.

checklist: Follow graph and feed membership model
Fan-out on write versus fan-out on read
Failure modes, hot accounts, and monitoring
followUps: How would you support a 'Following' and a 'For You' feed with different ranking?
What changes if a user follows 10,000 accounts?
How would you delete a post everywhere within a minute?
How would you A/B test a ranking change without double-counting reads?
commonMistakes: Fanning out every post to every follower, including celebrity accounts.
Ranking the entire feed on every read instead of precomputing or bounding the candidate set.
Using offset pagination, which duplicates or skips posts as new ones arrive.
Updating like counts synchronously on the post row.
Forgetting that a deleted or blocked post must disappear from precomputed feeds.
